A static SPA built with `@nuxt/vite-server` (`ssr: false`) has no server, so its document is rendered through the `render:html` and `render:document` hooks of renderer plugins as a prerendered route: once per build, for the base URL, with `import.meta.prerender` set. Anything the hooks add is the same for every visitor. In development, the document is rendered for each navigation. No other renderer hook is called for it.

+A virtual module registered with [`addServerTemplate`](/docs/api/kit/templates#addservertemplate) can be imported from server code, such as a renderer plugin, with both `@nuxt/nitro-server` and `@nuxt/vite-server`. Its contents are bundled into the server, so anything it imports has to resolve with the server builder in use.

+If your module writes to `nuxt.options.nitro.virtual`, or to `virtual` in the `nitro:config` hook, use `addServerTemplate` instead. The `nitro:config` hook is only called by the Nitro server builder.

Server plugins take variants too, although they are specific to Nitro so there is no generic `nuxt` variant to register. A plugin that only registers render hooks can be a [renderer plugin](#renderer-plugins) instead.

Because you never write the specifiers yourself, Nuxt can add, remove, or rename modules and your builder will keep working. The list also holds the virtual modules that Nuxt modules register with [`addServerTemplate`](/docs/api/kit/templates#addservertemplate), so registering every entry is all it takes to support them.

- **`defines`** are text replacements for `import.meta.dev`, `import.meta.server`, `import.meta.client`, and `import.meta.prerender` (and potentially other values). Apply them via a replacement transform. If you don't, unused branches stay in the bundle, and payload extraction and prerender caches will be disabled without any error.
- **`entry`** is the specifier your server entry imports `createNuxtRenderer` from.

- **`version`** verifies whether the version of Nuxt Kit your builder uses matches the one Nuxt is compatible with. Compare it with `SERVER_RUNTIME_VERSION`, and fail the build if they differ. That turns a breaking change into a clear error.
